data.raw_sensors: Create sensors for every raw field

data_description.tracked_clients: Create a device tracker and detail sensors (signal, SNR, rates, SSID) only for these client MAC addresses (pick from connected clients or type a MAC).
data_description.detailed_stats: Throughput and counters for Ethernet ports and SSID sub-interfaces, plus CPU and memory. Adds a few CLI commands per poll; turn off for a slow BR100.
data_description.raw_sensors: One sensor (disabled by default) for every other field the CLI reports, so you can enable anything you need.
data_description.enable_all_entities: Turn on every entity, including the diagnostic ones that are disabled by default (counters, raw fields, port switches).

run_show_command.name: Run show command
run_show_command.description: Run a read-only 'show' command on the device and return the raw output (for capturing parser samples).

command.name: Command
command.description: A command starting with 'show', e.g. 'show station'.

redact.name: Redact secrets
redact.description: Mask key/password arguments in the output.

set_ssid_password.name: Set SSID password
set_ssid_password.description: Change the WPA2-PSK key of an SSID and save the configuration.

password.name: Password
password.description: New key, 8-63 printable ASCII characters (no double quotes).

security_object.name: Security object
security_object.description: Security-object name. Looked up in the running config if omitted (falls back to the SSID name).

disconnect_client.name: Disconnect client
disconnect_client.description: De-authenticate a wireless client by MAC address.

mac.name: MAC address
mac.description: Client MAC address in any common format.

create_ssid.name: Create SSID
create_ssid.description: Create a new Wi-Fi network (security-object + SSID) and broadcast it, then save the configuration.

password.name: Password
password.description: WPA2-PSK key (8-63 characters). Leave empty for an open network.

radios.name: Radios
radios.description: Radios to broadcast on, e.g. wifi0, wifi1. Default: all active radios.

delete_ssid.name: Delete SSID
delete_ssid.description: Stop broadcasting an SSID and remove it (and its own security-object) from the configuration.

power_cycle_poe.name: Power cycle PoE port
power_cycle_poe.description: Turn PoE off for 5 seconds and on again (switches).

set_port.name: Enable or disable a port
set_port.description: Turn an Ethernet port on or off and save the configuration. Uplink ports are protected unless force is set.

force.name: Force
force.description: Also allow turning off an uplink port (may disconnect Home Assistant from the device).

backup_config.name: Back up configuration
backup_config.description: Read the device's configuration and save it to a backup file in Home Assistant (skipped if nothing changed since the last backup).

list_backups.name: List configuration backups
list_backups.description: List the configuration backups stored for a device.

save_config.name: Save configuration
save_config.description: Save the running configuration on the device so it survives a reboot or power loss.

restore_config.name: Restore configuration
restore_config.description: Send a configuration backup back to the device line by line. Lines the device rejects are reported; nothing is saved on the device unless save is on.

file.name: Backup file
file.description: File name from List configuration backups. Default: the latest backup.

save.name: Save on the device
save.description: Save the configuration on the device after restoring.

confirm.name: Confirm
confirm.description: Must be on: restoring changes the device configuration.

set_poe.name: Turn PoE on or off
set_poe.description: Turn Power over Ethernet on or off for one switch port and save the configuration.

set_port_description.name: Name a port
set_port_description.description: Set a switch port's display name (ExtremeXOS display string, up to 15 characters without spaces). Leave the name empty to clear it.

description.name: Name
description.description: New name, e.g. camera-1. Empty clears it.

reboot.name: Reboot
reboot.description: Reboot the device. On ExtremeXOS with unsaved changes the reboot is refused unless save changes is set, so nothing is lost by accident.

save_changes.name: Save changes
save_changes.description: On: save unsaved configuration changes first. Off: reboot and lose them. Not set: refuse if there are unsaved changes.

config_changed_after_reboot.title: {device}: configuration changed after a reboot
config_changed_after_reboot.description:
After its last reboot, {device} is running a configuration that differs from the backup taken on {backup} ({added} line(s) added, {removed} removed). This is what happens when unsaved changes are lost in a power cut, or the device boots an old or default configuration.

Changes:
```
{changes}
```

- If the backup is correct, run the **Restore configuration** action (`aerohive_local.restore_config`) for this device, with `save: true`.
- If the current configuration is correct, press **Accept current configuration** on the device page.

No new backup is taken until you do one of these, so the last known-good one stays available.

boot_config_problem.title: {device}: did not boot as configured
boot_config_problem.description:
{device} reports: {problems}.

This usually follows a power loss or a corrupted configuration file. Check `show switch` on the device. To boot the saved configuration again, run `use configuration primary` and then `reboot` on the switch, or restore the latest backup with the **Restore configuration** action.
